summary: Sleep Number Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a DIP Amendment to its prepetition credit agreement, securing $260M of debtor-in-possession financing from existing lenders. Terms include $65M of new money superpriority senior secured term loans (available in draws, up to $50M upon interim DIP order entry) and $195M of roll-up loans converting prepetition obligations. The Bankruptcy Court for S.D.N.Y. entered the interim DIP order on June 15, 2026; final hearing scheduled for July 9, 2026. Obligations are guaranteed by subsidiaries, secured by priming liens on DIP collateral, superpriority administrative expense status. Optional prepayments allowed with breakage/fees. Watch final DIP order approval and any potential restructuring plan or sale process, with risk-arb angle focused on whether DIP size suffices for operations and what emerges from Chapter 11.
